page.layout: One printed block only: an engraved bookplate (University of Michigan library ex-libris with crest, motto and frame) in the centre of the scan. Above it, handwritten shelf marks and stains, which are not printed text and are left out. No running text, no page number, no notes.
page.notes: The page carries only an engraved library bookplate: an oval crest with the date 1817 and the mottos "ARTES", "SCIENTIA", "VERITAS", the printed legend "LIBRARY OF THE UNIVERSITY OF MICHIGAN", a central shield with the word "TUEBOR" and a sun over water, the motto "SI QUAERIS PENINSULAM AMOENAM CIRCUMSPICE" on a scroll, and two stags supporting the shield. The engraving is described here and not transcribed as text. The handwritten shelf marks ("596", "E555 4", "u/") and the ink stains and show-through are not printed and are left out. A blue cover-like patch at the lower left is not printed text.
